QuestInfo.name: Asking After Maya, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p229#, the town clerk, is looking for someone to help with their work. Let's go check out #p235# in front of #m10001007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p229#, the town clerk, asked me to check on #b#p207##k, a resident of the town. Let's go see how #p207# is doing.\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked on #p207#, a resident of #m10001000#. I'm glad to see she's doing well!

0.0: "I'm curious to know how #p207#, one of #m10001000#'s residents, is doing lately. It would be wonderful if you could check on her for me.\r\n- #p229#"

1.0: Cough, cough... Oh, #h0#. It's so lovely to see you again. How has your adventuring been? You aren't hurt anywhere, are you?
1.1: To tell you the truth, I really find myself envying you, #h0#. #m10001000# is a truly wonderful town, but I hope to become healthy someday so I can travel all around the world, too. Oh dear, I've spent too much time complaining about my own troubles, haven't I? Cough, cough... Please, take good care of yourself.

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low, doesn't it?
